semantic.title: Semantic indexing
semantic.description: Configure code, documentation, and memory as independent domains. Vector storage is always local and split across small SQLite databases.
semantic.navHint: Local embeddings, reranking, coverage, and index generations
semantic.localOnly.title: Vectors stay on this machine
semantic.localOnly.description: Each project owns one vector database for code, snapshots, and project memories. Shared documentation and global memories use separate databases in the global semantic folder. A provider may receive text only when you explicitly select it for inference.
semantic.purpose.code.title: Code
semantic.purpose.docs.title: Documentation
semantic.purpose.docs.description: Shared collections with generations and backfills independent from agents.
semantic.purpose.memory.title: Memory

semantic.capability.rerank.description: Optionally reorders hybrid candidates after retrieval for better precision.
semantic.coverage.title: Vector coverage

semantic.actions.reindexProjectConfirm: Index code for {{project}} only? Work will run in bounded batches in the semantic worker.

semantic.onDemand.description: After the structural index is ready, a local ONNX or loopback profile starts or resumes background backfill only for the open project. Remote providers never start automatically. Reindex all remains an explicit global action.
